title: Follow-up fixes for javascript: URL navigation
body:
Follow-up fixes for javascript: URL navigation

* Note that the CSP check can rewrite the request's URL.
* Give the synthetic request a client, per w3c/trusted-types#548.
* Don't run the iframe load event steps when the default policy removed
  the container.
* Pass the navigation ID to "evaluate a javascript: URL".

This is a follow-up to 964f6664082d374fb496cda3cc956f2b68cf0d0c.
